three_things: Derrick White logs the most total minutes on the team (7,576.2), a reminder the minutes leader is not always the marquee name.

context_note: The 'top contributor' is the player with the most total minutes for the team across the sample, not necessarily the best or highest-scoring player -- which is why a complementary starter can lead here. PRA-per-36 sums points, rebounds, and assists per 36 minutes and is a raw box rate, not an impact metric. ppg_latest_season is a single-season team average while the rest of the sample spans three seasons; pace_proxy is a proxy, not official possession-based pace. The manifest is descriptive_only with no schedule or opponent adjustment.
